opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; must be a citizen of and based in a Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must have not received a BES Training and Travel Grant in the previous three years.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support researchers from Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel costs.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants 2026 (Round 2)

amount.raw: Maximum of £500 is available for events in person; up to £250 for virtual conferences

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES member; PhD student or postgraduate researcher; must be working or studying at a university or research institution; must attend a specialist field training course or present at a workshop/conference.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help PhD students and postgraduate researchers cover costs of specialist field training courses or travel to present their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Small Research Grants 2026 (Forthcoming)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers from all countries globally; projects must have a clear ecological science focus; funding not for salary of principal researcher, bench fees, or vehicle hire.
opportunities.summary: Funding for new and innovative ecological research projects, providing up to £5,000 to support work with a clear ecological focus.
